name: Carlos Gonzalez
bio:
Carlos Gonzalez is a highly skilled illustrator tattoo artist based out of Arteixo, A Coruña, crafting unique designs at Anden Tattoo. His artwork nuances coupled with his dedication to cleanliness ensure that each tattoo session is not only a creative journey but also held to the highest standards of hygiene. Clients appreciate the peace of mind that comes with his impeccable professionalism throughout the tattooing process.
